blurb: An `embed` becomes a `String`, which is Unicode text, so the file must be valid UTF-8. A file saved in another encoding, such as Latin-1, holds bytes that are not UTF-8 and cannot be read as text. Re-save it as UTF-8. A file that holds a NUL byte is binary and is `bynk.embed.binary_content`; a binary file belongs in `assets/`, as an `asset`.
example:
embed shell = "embeds/page.html"        // ✗ the file is Latin-1, not UTF-8
embed shell = "embeds/page.html"        // ✓ once the file is saved as UTF-8
summary: An `embed` names a file that is not valid UTF-8.
